senses.gloss:
1. दृप् दृप्, i. 4, Par. To be mad or extravagant, arrogant, Gīt. 9, 11. दृप्त,
 1. Wild, Rām. 1, 15, 7.
 2. Arrogant, MBh. 1, 162. Compar. दृप्ततर, Excessively arrogant, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 12.
 --Caus. दर्पय,
 1. To make mad, Kathās. 20, 64.
 2. To make arrogant or proud, Pañc. iii. d. 244.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. दर्पित,
 1. Wild, Bhartṛ. 3, 73.
 2. Proud, Man. 8, 371.
 --With the prep. अति अति, अतिदृप्त (rather दृप्त with अति), Excessively arrogant, Kathās. 20, 65.
 --Cf. probably δόρπον, a banquet.
† 2. दृप् दृप्, दृफ् दृफ्, दृम्फ् दृम्फ्, i. 6, Par. To hurt.
† 3. दृप् दृप्, i. 1 and 10, Par. To kindle.
